messages:
emma: planning a prod deploy for v2.4.5, targeting the 01:30-03:30 UTC change window. need prod deploy perms — my deployer role expired. will do a 5% canary then ramp. release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/v2.4.5 :slightly_smiling_face:
mike: that window works. are you running DB migrations? who will trigger the pipeline?
emma: migrations are feature-flagged, won't run automatically. i'll trigger the pipeline `infra/deploy/v2` from my laptop. canary -> 5% then 50 -> 100. requesting JIT access now.
jess: please pin the image and set fallback to v2.4.4 in the rollout config. also add a rollback tag `rollback=v2.4.4` in the release metadata.
emma: pinned image: `registry.redwood/internal:v2.4.5@sha256:abcd1234ef567890` — added rollback tag.
raj: I can grant a short-lived deployer role, but security needs to confirm MFA is enabled. @sarah any objections?
sarah: ok from security side for JIT if MFA is used and the request is recorded. follow the playbook: `auth request --role deployer --duration 30m` and paste the approval id here. no secrets/exfil allowed under JIT.
emma: running: `auth request --role deployer --duration 30m --reason "v2.4.5 canary"` -> approval id `jrt-2026-EMMA-42`
deploy-bot: JIT request jrt-2026-EMMA-42 submitted by emma, awaiting approver (roles: infra-admin,eng-release-lead)
raj: approved jrt-2026-EMMA-42. temp token issued: `XRW-TEMP-zzZ9` (30m). will monitor and revoke early if anything odd.
anya: heads-up from oncall — auto-rollback policy is set: if 2xx drops by >5% and error rate >1% for 5 minutes, rollback to `v2.4.4`. watch `/dashboards/serving/latency` and `/dashboards/serving/errors`.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline `infra/deploy/v2` started by emma (pipeline run id pr-8842). canary 5% starting now. logs: `kubectl rollout status deploy/llm-service --namespace prod`
emma: canary 5% up, health checks passing, no increased errors (observability snapshot: latency 82ms p95). ramping to 50%
deploy-bot: ramp to 50% complete, routing 50% traffic to v2.4.5@sha256:abcd1234ef567890
emma: monitoring looks good. increasing to 100%
deploy-bot: rollout complete — 100% traffic on v2.4.5@sha256:abcd1234ef567890. all pods ready.
mike: thanks — did you update the infra changelog and release notes? also leaving a note about rotating the deployer JIT privileges.
emma: release notes published: https://redwood.example/releases/v2.4.5/notes ; changelog entry created in repo `infra/CHANGELOG.md` with the image sha and migration flag.
sarah: please ensure the JIT session is closed and audit events are stored. I'll spot-check the audit log.
raj: revoking temp token now. token XRW-TEMP-zzZ9 revoked at 1990012398.
deploy-bot: token XRW-TEMP-zzZ9 revoked by raj. audit id audit-1990012398-raj.
emma: all good here, closing out. shout if we see any regressions. :tada:
